version: 1

# pipeline-run.sh --max-run-usd, charges a cap failure or a costless failed trial that

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# pipeline-run.sh — the cycle-130 ablation pipeline executor (SDD §1.4 D-4.1 … D-4.10, §5.6)
#
# Runs ONE task under ONE arm: materialises a sandbox repository (the task's
# fixture tree, or the review-catch PR under pr/, plus the Loa mount from the
# pinned --source-tree), then drives Loa's phases as separate `claude -p`
# sessions inside it, records every phase, enforces the per-run cap and writes
# meta/pipeline.json. One executor serves every task type (D-4.1):
#   review-catch                      REVIEW → AUDIT
#   bug-fix | refactor | feature-build PLAN → IMPLEMENT → REVIEW → FIX? → AUDIT → FIX?
# A FIX runs only when the gate before it wrote a CHANGES_REQUIRED LOA-VERDICT
# trailer (the last `<!-- LOA-VERDICT {…} -->` line of
# grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/engineer-feedback.md resp. auditor-sprint-feedback.md);
# a FIX that does not run is recorded `skipped: true`.
# Arms edit the phase set (D-4.2): `sprint_plan: false` drops PLAN; `gates: false`
# ends after IMPLEMENT; `loa_mount: false` runs one BARE session (no mount);
# `flatline: false` keeps PLAN with the Flatline step off; `context_resets: false`
# runs PLAN, IMPLEMENT and FIX as ONE implementer session (`--resume <session_id>`
# from the first session's system/init event) while REVIEW and AUDIT stay separate.
# LOA_EVAL_CONTAINER_CLAUDE_BIN (default claude), LOA_EVAL_EXECUTOR, LOA_ABLATION_BATCH_CONTEXT.
#
# Mount library: lib/sandbox-mount.sh beside this script, sourced by a literal path.
# Exported to it: ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE, ARM_ENV_FILE (meta/arm-env), LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE.

# Tested by evals/tests/pipeline-run.bats (stub claude, stub docker, and a temporary

set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C
shopt -u patsub_replacement 2>/dev/null || true   # bash 5.2: '&' in ${x//p/r} stays literal
done

for v in TASK_YAML ARM RUN_ID TRIAL SOURCE_TREE SUITE_FILE; do
  [[ -n "${!v}" ]] || die_usage "missing --$(echo "$v" | tr 'A-Z_' 'a-z-')"
done
[[ "$DRY_RUN" == true || -n "$RUN_DIR" ]] || die_usage "missing --run-dir"
[[ -f "$TASK_YAML" ]] || die_usage "task yaml not found: $TASK_YAML"

[[ -z "$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON" ]] || jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON" || die_usage "--phase-timeouts must be a JSON object"
[[ -n "$PHASE_MODELS_JSON" ]] || PHASE_MODELS_JSON='{}'
[[ -n "$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON" ]] || PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON='{}'

TASK_YAML="$(cd "$(dirname "$TASK_YAML")" && pwd)/$(basename "$TASK_YAML")"
TASK_DIR="$(dirname "$TASK_YAML")"
SUITE_ROOT="$(cd "$TASK_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
SOURCE_TREE="$(cd "$SOURCE_TREE" && pwd)"

TASK_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$TASK_YAML")" || die_usage "task yaml does not parse: $TASK_YAML"
SUITE_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$SUITE_FILE")" || die_usage "suite file does not parse: $SUITE_FILE"

if [[ -z "$MAX_RUN_USD" ]]; then
  MAX_RUN_USD="$(jq -r '.caps.run_usd // 12' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
  cfg_cap="$(yq -r '.evals.ablation.run_cap_usd // ""' "$REPO_ROOT/.loa.config.yaml" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  [[ -n "$cfg_cap" && "$cfg_cap" != "null" ]] && MAX_RUN_USD="$cfg_cap"
fi
[[ "$MAX_RUN_USD" =~ ^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$ ]] || die_usage "--max-run-usd must be a number"
CAP_MICRO="$(jq -n --arg c "$MAX_RUN_USD" '($c|tonumber) * 1000000 | round')"

TASK_ID="$(jq -r '.id // ""' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
TASK_TYPE="$(jq -r '.type // ""' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
[[ -n "$TASK_ID" ]] || die_usage "task has no id"
case "$TASK_TYPE" in
  review-catch) KIND="review-catch" ;;
  bug-fix|refactor|feature-build) KIND="build" ;;
  *) die_usage "task type '$TASK_TYPE' is not one of feature-build|bug-fix|refactor|review-catch" ;;
esac

OVERLAY_MODE="$(jq -r '.review_catch.overlay_mode // "head"' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
case "$OVERLAY_MODE" in head|base) ;; *) die_usage "task review_catch.overlay_mode must be head or base, got '$OVERLAY_MODE'" ;; esac

  REFUSAL="arm '$ARM' is not declared in the suite"
elif [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$ARM_DEF")" == "true" ]]; then
  REFUSAL="arm '$ARM' is declared absent: true"
elif ! jq -e --arg k "$KIND" --arg t "$TASK_TYPE" \
       '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \
       >/dev/null <<<"$ARM_DEF"; then
  REFUSAL="arm '$ARM' does not apply to task type '$TASK_TYPE' (task_types $(jq -c '.task_types' <<<"$ARM_DEF"))"

# runner marks the batch context; no pipeline.json, so no infrastructure_error row is possible
EVAL_ONLY=false; [[ "$(jq -r '.eval_only // false' <<<"$ARM_DEF")" == true ]] && EVAL_ONLY=true

  echo "pipeline-run.sh: refused: arm '$ARM': eval_only arm outside an evaluation batch (run-ablation.sh exports LOA_ABLATION_BATCH_CONTEXT=1 to its trials)" >&2
  exit 2
fi

# plan_phases <toggles-json> → JSON array of {name,label}
plan_phases() {
  jq -c -n --argjson arm "$ARM_DEF" --argjson suite "$SUITE_JSON" --argjson tg "$1" --arg kind "$KIND" '
    ( if $kind == "review-catch" then ["REVIEW","AUDIT"] else ["PLAN","IMPLEMENT","REVIEW","FIX","AUDIT","FIX"] end ) as $dflt
    | ( $arm.phases // $suite.phase_sets[$kind] // $dflt ) as $p0
    | ( if ($tg.loa_mount == false) then ["BARE"] else $p0 end ) as $p1
    | ( if ($tg.sprint_plan == false) then ($p1 | map(select(. != "PLAN"))) else $p1 end ) as $p2
    | ( if ($tg.gates == false) and ($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) != null
          then $p2[0:(($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) + 1)] else $p2 end ) as $p3
    | reduce $p3[] as $n ({out: [], fix: 0};
        if $n == "FIX" then .fix += 1 | .out += [{name: "FIX", label: ("FIX" + (.fix | tostring))}]
        else .out += [{name: $n, label: $n}] end)
    | .out'
}

phase_skill() {  # the Loa skill a phase invokes (for effort_requested)
  case "$1" in
    PLAN) echo planning-sprints ;; IMPLEMENT|FIX) echo implementing-tasks ;;
    REVIEW) echo reviewing-code ;; AUDIT) echo auditing-security ;; *) echo "" ;;
  esac
}
builtin_model() { case "$1" in REVIEW|AUDIT) echo global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1 ;; *) echo global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5 ;; esac; }
builtin_turns() { case "$1" in PLAN) echo 30 ;; IMPLEMENT) echo 60 ;; REVIEW|FIX|AUDIT) echo 40 ;; BARE) echo 170 ;; *) echo 40 ;; esac; }
builtin_tmin()  { case "$1" in PLAN) echo 15 ;; IMPLEMENT) echo 25 ;; REVIEW|AUDIT) echo 20 ;; FIX) echo 15 ;; BARE) echo 70 ;; *) echo 20 ;; esac; }

BARE_FABLE_MODEL="global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1"
BARE_MODEL_TOGGLE="$(jq -r '.bare_model // empty' <<<"$SUITE_TOGGLES")"   # re-read from the library's toggles below
phase_model() {  # bare_model: fable (cycle-131 D-5.1) decides BARE over every other source
  if [[ "$1" == BARE && "$BARE_MODEL_TOGGLE" == fable ]]; then printf '%s\n' "$BARE_FABLE_MODEL"; return 0; fi
  jq -r --arg n "$1" --arg d "$(builtin_model "$1")" --argjson o "$PHASE_MODELS_JSON" \
    '$o[$n] // .phase_defaults.models[$n] // $d' <<<"$SUITE_JSON"
}
phase_cap() {  # phase_cap <name> max_turns|timeout_min — task bounds > suite phase_defaults > built-in;
               # BARE without a declaration = PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 × FIX
  local n="$1" key="$2" v
  v="$(jq -r --arg n "$n" --arg k "$key" '.bounds[$k][$n] // empty' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
  [[ -n "$v" ]] || v="$(jq -r --arg n "$n" --arg k "$key" '.phase_defaults[$k][$n] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
  if [[ -z "$v" && "$n" == "BARE" ]]; then
    v=$(( $(phase_cap PLAN "$key") + $(phase_cap IMPLEMENT "$key") + 2 * $(phase_cap FIX "$key") ))
  fi
  if [[ -z "$v" ]]; then
    if [[ "$key" == max_turns ]]; then v="$(builtin_turns "$n")"; else v="$(builtin_tmin "$n")"; fi
  fi
  printf '%s' "$v"
}
phase_timeout_s() {
  local o; o="$(jq -r --arg n "$1" '.[$n] // empty' <<<"$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON")"
  if [[ -n "$o" ]]; then printf '%s' "$o"; else printf '%s' $(( $(phase_cap "$1" timeout_min) * 60 )); fi
}
TOOLS="$(jq -r --arg d "$TOOLS_DEFAULT" '.phase_defaults.tools // $d | if type == "array" then join(",") else . end' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
EFFORT_FLAG="$(jq -r '.effort // .toggles.effort // empty' <<<"$ARM_DEF")"
case "$EFFORT_FLAG" in ""|low|medium|high|xhigh|max) ;; *) die_usage "arm effort '$EFFORT_FLAG' is not low|medium|high|xhigh|max" ;; esac

if [[ "$DRY_RUN" == true ]]; then

  plan="$(plan_phases "$SUITE_TOGGLES")"
  single="$(jq -r '.context_resets == false' <<<"$SUITE_TOGGLES")"
  echo "plan: task $TASK_ID type $TASK_TYPE arm $ARM executor $EXECUTOR cap USD $MAX_RUN_USD phases $(jq -r 'map(.label + (if .name == "FIX" then "?" else "" end)) | join(",")' <<<"$plan")"
  i=0
  while IFS=$'\t' read -r name label; do
    i=$((i + 1))
    sess=new
    if [[ "$single" == true ]]; then case "$name" in PLAN|IMPLEMENT|FIX) sess=implementer ;; esac; fi
    cond=""; [[ "$name" == FIX ]] && cond=" when=CHANGES_REQUIRED"
    printf 'phase %d %s model=%s max_turns=%s timeout_s=%s effort=%s session=%s%s\n' "$i" "$label" \
      "$(phase_model "$name")" "$(phase_cap "$name" max_turns)" "$(phase_timeout_s "$name")" \
      "${EFFORT_FLAG:--}" "$sess" "$cond"
  done < <(jq -r '.[] | [.name, .label] | @tsv' <<<"$plan")
  # the sandbox plan: the mount, the closed-mount overlay, the eval config variant and the
  # arm's config edits (the keys apply_arm_toggles sets in the sandbox .loa.config.yaml)

    sb_mount=none sb_overlay="none(no mount)" sb_variant=none sb_edits=-
  else
    sb_mount=loa sb_variant=eval
    if [[ "$KIND" != review-catch ]]; then sb_overlay="none(build)"
    elif [[ "$(jq -r '.oracle_open' <<<"$SUITE_TOGGLES")" == true ]]; then sb_overlay="none(oracle_open)"
    else sb_overlay="$OVERLAY_MODE"; fi
    sb_edits="$(jq -r '[ (if .companion_voice == false then "flatline_protocol.code_review.companion_voice=false", "flatline_protocol.security_audit.companion_voice=false" else empty end),
                         (if .gates == false then "flatline_protocol.code_review.enabled=false", "flatline_protocol.security_audit.enabled=false" else empty end),
                         (if .dissent == false and .gates != false then "flatline_protocol.code_review.enabled=false" else empty end),
                         (if .flatline == false then "flatline_protocol.enabled=false" else empty end) ]
                       | if length == 0 then "-" else join(",") end' <<<"$SUITE_TOGGLES")"
  fi
  printf 'sandbox: mount=%s overlay=%s config_variant=%s config_edits=%s\n' "$sb_mount" "$sb_overlay" "$sb_variant" "$sb_edits"
  [[ "$EVAL_ONLY" == true ]] && echo "eval_only: true (batch context LOA_ABLATION_BATCH_CONTEXT=1)"
  exit 0
fi

CAP_MICRO="$(jq -n --arg c "$MAX_RUN_USD" '($c|tonumber) * 1000000 | round')"

TASK_ID="$(jq -r '.id // ""' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
TASK_TYPE="$(jq -r '.type // ""' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
[[ -n "$TASK_ID" ]] || die_usage "task has no id"
case "$TASK_TYPE" in
  review-catch) KIND="review-catch" ;;
  bug-fix|refactor|feature-build) KIND="build" ;;
  *) die_usage "task type '$TASK_TYPE' is not one of feature-build|bug-fix|refactor|review-catch" ;;
esac

OVERLAY_MODE="$(jq -r '.review_catch.overlay_mode // "head"' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
case "$OVERLAY_MODE" in head|base) ;; *) die_usage "task review_catch.overlay_mode must be head or base, got '$OVERLAY_MODE'" ;; esac

# --- arm and phase plan -------------------------------------------------------
ARM_DEF="$(jq -c --arg a "$ARM" '[.arms // [] | .[] | select(.id == $a)][0] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
ALL_ARM_IDS="$(jq -r '[.arms // [] | .[] | .id] | .[]' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
REFUSAL=""
if [[ -z "$ARM_DEF" ]]; then
  REFUSAL="arm '$ARM' is not declared in the suite"
elif [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$ARM_DEF")" == "true" ]]; then
  REFUSAL="arm '$ARM' is declared absent: true"
elif ! jq -e --arg k "$KIND" --arg t "$TASK_TYPE" \
       '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \
       >/dev/null <<<"$ARM_DEF"; then
  REFUSAL="arm '$ARM' does not apply to task type '$TASK_TYPE' (task_types $(jq -c '.task_types' <<<"$ARM_DEF"))"
fi
[[ -n "$ARM_DEF" ]] || ARM_DEF='{}'
SUITE_TOGGLES="$(jq -c '.toggles // {}' <<<"$ARM_DEF")"

# runner marks the batch context; no pipeline.json, so no infrastructure_error row is possible
EVAL_ONLY=false; [[ "$(jq -r '.eval_only // false' <<<"$ARM_DEF")" == true ]] && EVAL_ONLY=true
if [[ "$EVAL_ONLY" == true && "${LOA_ABLATION_BATCH_CONTEXT:-}" != 1 ]]; then

fi

# plan_phases <toggles-json> → JSON array of {name,label}
plan_phases() {
  jq -c -n --argjson arm "$ARM_DEF" --argjson suite "$SUITE_JSON" --argjson tg "$1" --arg kind "$KIND" '
    ( if $kind == "review-catch" then ["REVIEW","AUDIT"] else ["PLAN","IMPLEMENT","REVIEW","FIX","AUDIT","FIX"] end ) as $dflt
    | ( $arm.phases // $suite.phase_sets[$kind] // $dflt ) as $p0
    | ( if ($tg.loa_mount == false) then ["BARE"] else $p0 end ) as $p1
    | ( if ($tg.sprint_plan == false) then ($p1 | map(select(. != "PLAN"))) else $p1 end ) as $p2
    | ( if ($tg.gates == false) and ($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) != null
          then $p2[0:(($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) + 1)] else $p2 end ) as $p3
    | reduce $p3[] as $n ({out: [], fix: 0};
        if $n == "FIX" then .fix += 1 | .out += [{name: "FIX", label: ("FIX" + (.fix | tostring))}]

}

phase_skill() {  # the Loa skill a phase invokes (for effort_requested)
  case "$1" in
    PLAN) echo planning-sprints ;; IMPLEMENT|FIX) echo implementing-tasks ;;
    REVIEW) echo reviewing-code ;; AUDIT) echo auditing-security ;; *) echo "" ;;
  esac
}
builtin_model() { case "$1" in REVIEW|AUDIT) echo global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1 ;; *) echo global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5 ;; esac; }
builtin_turns() { case "$1" in PLAN) echo 30 ;; IMPLEMENT) echo 60 ;; REVIEW|FIX|AUDIT) echo 40 ;; BARE) echo 170 ;; *) echo 40 ;; esac; }
builtin_tmin()  { case "$1" in PLAN) echo 15 ;; IMPLEMENT) echo 25 ;; REVIEW|AUDIT) echo 20 ;; FIX) echo 15 ;; BARE) echo 70 ;; *) echo 20 ;; esac; }

BARE_MODEL_TOGGLE="$(jq -r '.bare_model // empty' <<<"$SUITE_TOGGLES")"   # re-read from the library's toggles below
phase_model() {  # bare_model: fable (cycle-131 D-5.1) decides BARE over every other source
  if [[ "$1" == BARE && "$BARE_MODEL_TOGGLE" == fable ]]; then printf '%s\n' "$BARE_FABLE_MODEL"; return 0; fi
  jq -r --arg n "$1" --arg d "$(builtin_model "$1")" --argjson o "$PHASE_MODELS_JSON" \
    '$o[$n] // .phase_defaults.models[$n] // $d' <<<"$SUITE_JSON"
}
phase_cap() {  # phase_cap <name> max_turns|timeout_min — task bounds > suite phase_defaults > built-in;
               # BARE without a declaration = PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 × FIX
  local n="$1" key="$2" v
  v="$(jq -r --arg n "$n" --arg k "$key" '.bounds[$k][$n] // empty' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
  [[ -n "$v" ]] || v="$(jq -r --arg n "$n" --arg k "$key" '.phase_defaults[$k][$n] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
  if [[ -z "$v" && "$n" == "BARE" ]]; then
    v=$(( $(phase_cap PLAN "$key") + $(phase_cap IMPLEMENT "$key") + 2 * $(phase_cap FIX "$key") ))
  fi
  if [[ -z "$v" ]]; then
    if [[ "$key" == max_turns ]]; then v="$(builtin_turns "$n")"; else v="$(builtin_tmin "$n")"; fi
  fi
  printf '%s' "$v"
}
phase_timeout_s() {
  local o; o="$(jq -r --arg n "$1" '.[$n] // empty' <<<"$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON")"
  if [[ -n "$o" ]]; then printf '%s' "$o"; else printf '%s' $(( $(phase_cap "$1" timeout_min) * 60 )); fi
}
TOOLS="$(jq -r --arg d "$TOOLS_DEFAULT" '.phase_defaults.tools // $d | if type == "array" then join(",") else . end' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
EFFORT_FLAG="$(jq -r '.effort // .toggles.effort // empty' <<<"$ARM_DEF")"
case "$EFFORT_FLAG" in ""|low|medium|high|xhigh|max) ;; *) die_usage "arm effort '$EFFORT_FLAG' is not low|medium|high|xhigh|max" ;; esac

if [[ "$DRY_RUN" == true ]]; then
  if [[ -n "$REFUSAL" ]]; then echo "pipeline-run.sh: refused: $REFUSAL" >&2; exit 2; fi
  plan="$(plan_phases "$SUITE_TOGGLES")"
  single="$(jq -r '.context_resets == false' <<<"$SUITE_TOGGLES")"
  echo "plan: task $TASK_ID type $TASK_TYPE arm $ARM executor $EXECUTOR cap USD $MAX_RUN_USD phases $(jq -r 'map(.label + (if .name == "FIX" then "?" else "" end)) | join(",")' <<<"$plan")"
  i=0
  while IFS=$'\t' read -r name label; do
    i=$((i + 1))
    sess=new
    if [[ "$single" == true ]]; then case "$name" in PLAN|IMPLEMENT|FIX) sess=implementer ;; esac; fi
    cond=""; [[ "$name" == FIX ]] && cond=" when=CHANGES_REQUIRED"
    printf 'phase %d %s model=%s max_turns=%s timeout_s=%s effort=%s session=%s%s\n' "$i" "$label" \
      "$(phase_model "$name")" "$(phase_cap "$name" max_turns)" "$(phase_timeout_s "$name")" \
      "${EFFORT_FLAG:--}" "$sess" "$cond"
  done < <(jq -r '.[] | [.name, .label] | @tsv' <<<"$plan")
  # the sandbox plan: the mount, the closed-mount overlay, the eval config variant and the
  # arm's config edits (the keys apply_arm_toggles sets in the sandbox .loa.config.yaml)
  if [[ "$(jq -r '.loa_mount' <<<"$SUITE_TOGGLES")" == false ]]; then
    sb_mount=none sb_overlay="none(no mount)" sb_variant=none sb_edits=-
  else
    sb_mount=loa sb_variant=eval
    if [[ "$KIND" != review-catch ]]; then sb_overlay="none(build)"
    elif [[ "$(jq -r '.oracle_open' <<<"$SUITE_TOGGLES")" == true ]]; then sb_overlay="none(oracle_open)"
    else sb_overlay="$OVERLAY_MODE"; fi
    sb_edits="$(jq -r '[ (if .companion_voice == false then "flatline_protocol.code_review.companion_voice=false", "flatline_protocol.security_audit.companion_voice=false" else empty end),
                         (if .gates == false then "flatline_protocol.code_review.enabled=false", "flatline_protocol.security_audit.enabled=false" else empty end),
                         (if .dissent == false and .gates != false then "flatline_protocol.code_review.enabled=false" else empty end),
                         (if .flatline == false then "flatline_protocol.enabled=false" else empty end) ]
                       | if length == 0 then "-" else join(",") end' <<<"$SUITE_TOGGLES")"
  fi
  printf 'sandbox: mount=%s overlay=%s config_variant=%s config_edits=%s\n' "$sb_mount" "$sb_overlay" "$sb_variant" "$sb_edits"
  [[ "$EVAL_ONLY" == true ]] && echo "eval_only: true (batch context LOA_ABLATION_BATCH_CONTEXT=1)"
  exit 0
fi

     3	# validate-suite.sh — cycle-130 ablation task-suite validator (SDD §3.2, DEC-0424)
     4	#
     5	# Checks every task of the ablation-2.0 suite before it is frozen, run or graded.
     6	#
     7	# Usage:
     8	#   validate-suite.sh [--root DIR] [--smoke] [--allow-partial] [--suite-file F]
     9	#
    10	#   --root DIR        suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0); the
    11	#                     tasks are <root>/tasks/<id>/task.yaml
    12	#   --smoke           also validate <root>/smoke/<id>/task.yaml (never counted)
    13	#   --allow-partial   skip the four-by-four type count (Sprint 258 state)
    14	#   --suite-file F    suite yaml (default evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml): arm ids
    15	#                     for the leakage check, arms' task_types, suite_version
    16	#
    17	# Checks (each violation is one stdout line `<task-id>: <reason>`):
    18	#   1. schema: id (= directory name), schema_version 1, type (feature-build |
    19	#      bug-fix | refactor | review-catch), source {kind, date, fix_commit?,
    20	#      base_commit?, bead?, origin?, churn?} (churn: {files, insertions,
    21	#      deletions}, non-negative integers; Sprint 259), post_cutoff (bool), fixture (dir under the
    22	#      root; null only for review-catch), criterion (agent-facing; no path, file
    23	#      name or test name), success_criterion, test_command (array; null only for
    24	#      review-catch), regression_command (array | null), reference_patch (hidden/…
    25	#      | null; required for bug-fix and feature-build), grader_protected (array of
    26	#      relative paths present in the fixture; for build types it lists every file
    27	#      under fixture/tests/, Sprint 259), structural_check (hidden/… | null;
    28	#      refactor: regression_command must be null — test_command is the regression check),
    29	#      required for refactor), bounds {max_turns{}, timeout_min{}} (phase → positive
    30	#      int), review_catch (null, or {fixture, manifest, labels?} for review-catch,
    31	#      both present), suite_version (= the suite file's), TASK.md present
    32	#   2. counts: four tasks of each type under tasks/ (unless --allow-partial)
    33	#   3. allowlist: test_command[0] and regression_command[0] in python3 | pytest |
    34	#      bats | bash | node | npx
    35	#   4. hidden/manifest.json (build types): {"files": [{src, dest}]}; every src
    36	#      exists under hidden/; every dest is relative, inside the tree, no `..`
    37	#   5. fixture path rule (build types): check_fixture_path_rule from
    38	#      lib/sandbox-mount.sh — no .claude/, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml, grimoires/
    39	#      or .run/ at the fixture's top level; the reference patch touches none either
    40	#   6. leakage: TASK.md and criterion (the task-brief text is built from these)
    41	#      and every phase prompt under evals/harness/lib/phase-prompts/ contain none
    42	#      of: the string `hidden` (any case), a hidden test file's stem, a defect id
    43	#      of the review manifest, a `D[0-9]{2}-` key, an arm id of the suite file
    44	#   7. suite file: every non-absent arm's task_types are known (all | build |
    45	#      review-catch | feature-build | bug-fix | refactor)
    46	#   8. suite file arms (cycle-131 FR-5): `toggles` is a mapping whose every key is in
    47	#      the vocabulary of lib/sandbox-mount.sh apply_arm_toggles with a value it defines
    48	#      (companion_voice, karpathy_block, rule_files, audit_delta_instruction, loa_mount,
    49	#      gates, flatline, sprint_plan, context_resets, dissent: false; effort:
    50	#      low|medium|high|xhigh|max; bare_model: fable; oracle_open: true); `took_effect`
    51	#      is a list whose every id is a rule took-effect.sh defines (its `rule_<id>()`
    52	#      functions, read from the script beside this one); `eval_only`, when present, is
    53	#      a boolean; an arm whose toggles set oracle_open: true carries eval_only: true
    54	#
    55	# Exit: 0 valid; 1 violations (every one listed); 2 usage / unreadable input.
    56	# Tested by evals/tests/validate-suite.bats.
    57	# =============================================================================
    58	set -euo pipefail
    59	export LC_ALL=C
    60	
    61	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    62	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    63	ROOT="$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0"
    64	SUITE_FILE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
    65	PROMPTS_DIR="${LOA_EVAL_PHASE_PROMPTS_DIR:-$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/phase-prompts}"
    66	SMOKE=false ALLOW_PARTIAL=false
2:# =============================================================================
157:# =============================================================================

#!/usr/bin/env bats
# =============================================================================
# evals/tests/validate-suite.bats — cycle-130 Sprint 258 Task 1.11 (DEC-0424,
# sprint AC-1.13, SDD §3.2)
#
# validate-suite.sh on fixture suites built from the committed smoke tasks
# (fixtures/ablation/suite-lib.bash): each check's pass and fail — schema, the
# four-by-four counts (relaxed by --allow-partial), the test_command allowlist,
# hidden/manifest.json destinations, the fixture path rule, leakage strings in
# TASK.md / criterion / phase prompts, the suite file's task_types.
# =============================================================================

setup() {
  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
  VS="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/validate-suite.sh"
  SUITE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/vs.XXXXXX")"
  R="$T/suite"; mkdir -p "$R"
  # no phase prompts unless a test supplies them
  export LOA_EVAL_PHASE_PROMPTS_DIR="$T/no-prompts"
  # shellcheck source=fixtures/ablation/suite-lib.bash
  source "$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/ablation/suite-lib.bash"
}

teardown() {
  find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
  rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true
}

@test "VS-1 the committed suite (tasks/ and smoke/) validates with --allow-partial; without it, every type short of four tasks is one counts line" {
  CR="$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0"
  n="$(find "$CR/tasks" "$CR/smoke" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -name task.yaml 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
  short=0
  for ty in feature-build bug-fix refactor review-catch; do
    c="$(cat "$CR"/tasks/*/task.yaml 2>/dev/null | grep -c "^type: $ty\$" || true)"
    [ "$c" -eq 4 ] || short=$((short + 1))
  done
  run "$VS" --smoke --allow-partial
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  grep -q "OK — $n task(s) valid" <<<"$output"
  run "$VS" --smoke
  [ "$(grep -c 'counts:' <<<"$output")" -eq "$short" ]
  if [ "$short" -gt 0 ]; then [ "$status" -eq 1 ]; else [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; fi
}

@test "VS-2 a four-by-four suite validates; one task short fails the counts unless --allow-partial; smoke tasks never count" {
  make_full_suite "$R"
  run "$VS" --root "$R"
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  grep -q 'OK — 16 task(s) valid' <<<"$output"
  find "$R/tasks/refactor-04" -delete
  run "$VS" --root "$R"
  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
  grep -q 'suite: counts: 3 refactor task(s) under tasks/, want 4' <<<"$output"
  run "$VS" --root "$R" --allow-partial
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  make_task "$R" smoke smoke-refactor-x refactor
  run "$VS" --root "$R" --smoke
  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]

@test "RAB-c131-3 oracle_closed on a1_full (cycle-131 FR-1): took-effect gets --task-yaml and passes on an overlaid review-catch run; a run without the overlay pauses the arm" {
  ra --arms a1_full --tasks review-01 --trials-review 1 --batch oc1 --concurrency 1
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ] || { echo "$output"; false; }
  grep -q 'arm a1_full: oracle_closed OK ok head:' "$RES/oc1/a1_full/review-01-t1.log"
  rules 'oc2-a1_full-review-01-t1 bad_overlay'
  ra --arms a1_full --tasks review-01,review-02 --trials-review 1 --batch oc2 --concurrency 1
  [ "$status" -ne 0 ]
  [ "$(row oc2-a1_full-review-01-t1 | jq -r '.status')" = infrastructure_error ]
  jq -e '.paused_arms.a1_full | test("oracle_closed FAIL")' "$RES/oc2/STATUS.json" >/dev/null
}

@test "RAB-c131-4 bare_model: fable (cycle-131 D-5.1): a BARE phase on Fable 5.1 is not drift, and bare_model_fable passes; another model in that BARE record is drift" {
  cp "$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml" "$T/suite.yaml"
  yq -i '.arms += [{"id": "a0_bare_fable", "label": "A0F", "task_types": ["review-catch"], "toggles": {"loa_mount": false, "bare_model": "fable"},
                    "phases": ["BARE"], "effort": "high", "took_effect": ["no_dot_claude", "bare_model_fable"]}]' "$T/suite.yaml"
  ra --suite-file "$T/suite.yaml" --arms a0_bare_fable --tasks review-01 --trials-review 1 --batch bf1 --concurrency 1
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ] || { echo "$output"; cat "$RES/bf1/a0_bare_fable/review-01-t1.log"; false; }
  [ "$(jq -r '.drift' "$RES/bf1/STATUS.json")" = null ]
  grep -q 'arm a0_bare_fable: bare_model_fable OK BARE models_used global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1, effort_requested high' "$RES/bf1/a0_bare_fable/review-01-t1.log"

  ra --suite-file "$T/suite.yaml" --arms a0_bare_fable --tasks review-01 --trials-review 1 --batch bf2 --concurrency 1
  [ "$status" -eq 3 ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.drift.field' "$RES/bf2/STATUS.json")" = models_used.BARE ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.drift.expected' "$RES/bf2/STATUS.json")" = claude-fable-5-1 ]

  yq -i 'del(.caps.run_usd_by_type)' "$T/v1.yaml"

  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]

  cp "$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml" "$T/half.yaml"
  yq -i 'del(.caps.run_usd_by_type["review-catch"])' "$T/half.yaml"

def render_extra_sens(L, V, rules, h):
    """report 1.3: the oracle-exposed and dissent-absent sensitivities, with the cells each rule excluded
    per arm printed beside every read"""
    for key in ("oracle_exposed_excluded", "dissent_absent_excluded"):
        X = V["extra_sens"][key]
        L(f"{h} Sensitivity: {X['label']} — decides nothing")
        L("")
        counts = ", ".join(f"`{a}` {n}" for a, n in X["counts"].items()) or "none"
        L(f"- rows this rule excluded, per arm: {counts}")
        if key == "oracle_exposed_excluded":
            rep_ = ", ".join(f"`{a}` {n}" for a, n in X["reported"].items()) or "none"
            L(f"- oracle-exposed rows of an oracle_open arm (reported, not excluded): {rep_}")
        else:
            L("- a planned absence (dissent_absent_reason disabled) is never excluded; budget, preflight and error are")
        L("")
        L("| component | arm | n pairs | pass-rate Δ [90 % CI] | catch-rate Δ [90 % CI] (defects) | excluded by the rule | "
          "predicate outcome (not used) |")
        L("|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
        for d in X["rows"]:
            cp = {p["metric"]: p for p in d["comparisons"]}
            npairs = ", ".join(f"{p['n']} {p['unit']}" for p in d["comparisons"])
            catch = interval(cp.get(CATCH)) if CATCH in cp else "n/a (build-only)"
            L(f"| {d['arm_label']} | `{d['arm']}` | {npairs} | {interval(cp.get(PASS))} | {catch} | "
              f"{X['counts'].get(d['arm'], 0)} (control {X['counts'].get(CONTROL, 0)}) | {d['predicate_label']} |")
        L("")
        render_h1a4(L, X["h"], rules, prefix=f"sensitivity ({X['label']}; decides nothing): ",
                    suffix=f" (excluded: a1_full {X['counts'].get(CONTROL, 0)}, a0_bare {X['counts'].get(BARE, 0)})")


def render_sens(L, V, rules, h):
    L("| component | arm | n pairs | pass-rate Δ [90 % CI] | catch-rate Δ [90 % CI] (defects) | cost Δ % | "
      "wall-clock Δ % | excluded share | predicate outcome (not used) |")
    L("|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
    for d in V["sens_rows"]:
        cp = {p["metric"]: p for p in d["comparisons"]}
        npairs = ", ".join(f"{p['n']} {p['unit']}" for p in d["comparisons"])
        catch = interval(cp.get(CATCH)) if CATCH in cp else "n/a (build-only)"
        share = "n/a" if d["excluded_share"] is None else f"{d['excluded_share']:.3f}"
        L(f"| {d['arm_label']} | `{d['arm']}` | {npairs} | {interval(cp.get(PASS))} | {catch} | {pct(d['c'])} | "
          f"{pct(d['w'])} | {share} | {d['predicate_label']} |")
    L("")
    L(f"{h} H1 and A4 lines, sensitivity ({SENS_H_TREATMENT}; decides nothing)")
    L("")
    render_h1a4(L, V["sens_h"], rules, prefix=SENS_PREFIX, suffix=f" ({SENS_H_TREATMENT})")


def analyse(suite, vrows, mans, args, cuts, components, v):
    """Every figure of one suite_version (the rows of no other version enter)."""
    seed = args.seed
    main_extra = oracle_reason if getattr(args, "exclude_oracle_exposed", "false") == "true" else None
    main = Analysis(suite, vrows, mans, args, cap_excluded=False, extra=main_extra)
    sens = Analysis(suite, vrows, mans, args, cap_excluded=True, extra=main_extra)
    decisions = [main.arm_report(a, cuts, seed) for a in components]
    sens_rows = [sens.arm_report(a, {}, seed) for a in components]

    H = h1a4(main, v, seed)
    h1_state, a4_state = H["h1_state"], H["a4_state"]
    sens_h = h1a4(Analysis(suite, vrows, mans, args, cap_excluded=True, include_degraded=True), v, seed)
    decidable = any(d["decidable"] for d in decisions) or h1_state in H1_DECIDED or a4_state in A4_DECIDED
    caps = [c["valid"] for (_, _), trials in sorted(main.cells.items()) for _, c in sorted(trials.items())
            if c["valid"] is not None and c["valid"]["status"] == "cap_failure"]
    batches = sorted({r["batch"] for r in vrows})
    shas = sorted({str(mans[b].get("suite_manifest_sha256")) for b in batches
                   if b in mans and mans[b].get("suite_manifest_sha256") not in (None, "")}
                  | {str(r.get("suite_manifest_sha256")) for r in vrows if r.get("suite_manifest_sha256") not in (None, "")})
    # report 1.3: the two labelled sensitivities (decide nothing); planned dissent absence never excludes
    extra = {}
    for key, label, fn in (("oracle_exposed_excluded", ORACLE_LABEL, oracle_reason),
                           ("dissent_absent_excluded", DISSENT_LABEL, dissent_reason)):
        an = Analysis(suite, vrows, mans, args, cap_excluded=False, extra=fn)
        extra[key] = {"label": label, "an": an, "rows": [an.arm_report(a, {}, seed) for a in components],
                      "h": h1a4(an, v, seed), "counts": dict(sorted(an.extra_excluded.items())),
                      "reported": dict(sorted(an.open_reported.items()))}

def render_extra_sens(L, V, rules, h):
    """report 1.3: the oracle-exposed and dissent-absent sensitivities, with the cells each rule excluded
    per arm printed beside every read"""
    for key in ("oracle_exposed_excluded", "dissent_absent_excluded"):
        X = V["extra_sens"][key]
        L(f"{h} Sensitivity: {X['label']} — decides nothing")
        L("")
        counts = ", ".join(f"`{a}` {n}" for a, n in X["counts"].items()) or "none"
        L(f"- rows this rule excluded, per arm: {counts}")
        if key == "oracle_exposed_excluded":
            rep_ = ", ".join(f"`{a}` {n}" for a, n in X["reported"].items()) or "none"
            L(f"- oracle-exposed rows of an oracle_open arm (reported, not excluded): {rep_}")
        else:
            L("- a planned absence (dissent_absent_reason disabled) is never excluded; budget, preflight and error are")
        L("")
        L("| component | arm | n pairs | pass-rate Δ [90 % CI] | catch-rate Δ [90 % CI] (defects) | excluded by the rule | "

        L("|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|")

def render_sens(L, V, rules, h):
    L("| component | arm | n pairs | pass-rate Δ [90 % CI] | catch-rate Δ [90 % CI] (defects) | cost Δ % | "
      "wall-clock Δ % | excluded share | predicate outcome (not used) |")
    L("|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
    for d in V["sens_rows"]:
        cp = {p["metric"]: p for p in d["comparisons"]}
        npairs = ", ".join(f"{p['n']} {p['unit']}" for p in d["comparisons"])
        catch = interval(cp.get(CATCH)) if CATCH in cp else "n/a (build-only)"
        share = "n/a" if d["excluded_share"] is None else f"{d['excluded_share']:.3f}"
        L(f"| {d['arm_label']} | `{d['arm']}` | {npairs} | {interval(cp.get(PASS))} | {catch} | {pct(d['c'])} | "
          f"{pct(d['w'])} | {share} | {d['predicate_label']} |")
    L("")
    L(f"{h} H1 and A4 lines, sensitivity ({SENS_H_TREATMENT}; decides nothing)")
    L("")
    render_h1a4(L, V["sens_h"], rules, prefix=SENS_PREFIX, suffix=f" ({SENS_H_TREATMENT})")


def analyse(suite, vrows, mans, args, cuts, components, v):
    """Every figure of one suite_version (the rows of no other version enter)."""
    seed = args.seed
    main_extra = oracle_reason if getattr(args, "exclude_oracle_exposed", "false") == "true" else None
    main = Analysis(suite, vrows, mans, args, cap_excluded=False, extra=main_extra)
    sens = Analysis(suite, vrows, mans, args, cap_excluded=True, extra=main_extra)
    decisions = [main.arm_report(a, cuts, seed) for a in components]
    sens_rows = [sens.arm_report(a, {}, seed) for a in components]

    H = h1a4(main, v, seed)
    h1_state, a4_state = H["h1_state"], H["a4_state"]
    sens_h = h1a4(Analysis(suite, vrows, mans, args, cap_excluded=True, include_degraded=True), v, seed)
    decidable = any(d["decidable"] for d in decisions) or h1_state in H1_DECIDED or a4_state in A4_DECIDED
    caps = [c["valid"] for (_, _), trials in sorted(main.cells.items()) for _, c in sorted(trials.items())
            if c["valid"] is not None and c["valid"]["status"] == "cap_failure"]
    batches = sorted({r["batch"] for r in vrows})
    shas = sorted({str(mans[b].get("suite_manifest_sha256")) for b in batches
                   if b in mans and mans[b].get("suite_manifest_sha256") not in (None, "")}
                  | {str(r.get("suite_manifest_sha256")) for r in vrows if r.get("suite_manifest_sha256") not in (None, "")})
    # report 1.3: the two labelled sensitivities (decide nothing); planned dissent absence never excludes
    extra = {}
    for key, label, fn in (("oracle_exposed_excluded", ORACLE_LABEL, oracle_reason),
                           ("dissent_absent_excluded", DISSENT_LABEL, dissent_reason)):
        an = Analysis(suite, vrows, mans, args, cap_excluded=False, extra=fn)
        extra[key] = {"label": label, "an": an, "rows": [an.arm_report(a, {}, seed) for a in components],
                      "h": h1a4(an, v, seed), "counts": dict(sorted(an.extra_excluded.items())),
                      "reported": dict(sorted(an.open_reported.items()))}
    return dict(H, rows=vrows, main=main, sens=sens, decisions=decisions, sens_rows=sens_rows,
                decidable=decidable, caps=caps, batches=batches, shas=shas, sens_h=sens_h,
                budget=budget_matched(main, v), extra_sens=extra)

head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:1913 — Excluding the eval_only arm from `components` drops it from everything the report renders. `detail_arms` (line 2003), the decisions, the sensitivity rows and the two extra sensitivities (`analyse`, lines 1665-1683) are all built from `components`, so a1_full_openmount's rows never appear anywhere. That arm exists to run the open-mount vs closed-mount oracle A/B, so a batch that pays for it gets no result back. Keep it out of the decisions and the EFP count, but still report it (per-arm detail and/or an evaluation-only comparison against a1_full).
head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:1913 — a0_bare_fable (a baseline variant: A0 on the review model), a1_review_only and a1_no_dissent now count as decision components. They get keep/remove/simplify predicates against a1_full (a "remove a0_bare_fable" verdict means nothing for a baseline), and k goes from 6 to 9. The pre-registered D-A5 analysis (rules block "over 6 components"; EFP 0.3 → 0.45 per direction) is changed after registration. Existing suite-v2 reports also gain three inconclusive "no valid pair" rows. The test comment at head/evals/tests/ablation-report.bats:189 itself calls these "control arms". Either keep them out of `components` as well, or record the change to the pre-registration explicitly (rules block + NOTES).
head/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml:117 — The pre-registered rules block still says "expected false positives at 0.90 over 6 components printed", but the report now prints 9 components. The report quotes this block verbatim in its Method section, so it now contradicts the EFP sentence it prints.
head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:1930 — The EFP precision change from .1f to .2f silently rewrites the printed pre-registered sentence for every existing report (0.3 → 0.30, 0.6 → 0.60). Anything that quotes the old sentence (NOTES, earlier reports) no longer matches. This needs to be a deliberate, documented change, not a side effect.
head/evals/tests/run-ablation.bats:1174 — RAB-c131-4 still appends its own a0_bare_fable arm to a copy of the committed suite, which now declares a0_bare_fable too. That gives a duplicate arm id. run-ablation.sh:576 and pipeline-run.sh resolve arms by first match, so the committed definition (different took_effect list) wins. The test no longer exercises the arm it builds and passes or fails for reasons unrelated to its setup. Drop the append, as the PR did for c131_arms in pipeline-run.bats.
head/evals/harness/validate-suite.sh:157 — The new arm schema check (check 8) does not reject duplicate arm ids, although every consumer resolves an arm by first match (exactly the RAB-c131-4 case above). Add a duplicate-id violation alongside the toggle/took_effect/eval_only checks.
head/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml:100 — a1_review_only and a1_no_dissent (line 102) name the took-effect rules `review_only_phases` and `no_review_dissent_envelope`. took-effect.sh is not part of this change, and nothing else in the PR implements or exercises these rules (only the suite and the VS-14 name loop mention them). If they are not already defined, every trial of these two arms becomes infrastructure_error and pauses the arm, and validate-suite now fails the committed suite (VS-1/VS-14). Include or reference the rule implementations and a took-effect test for them.
head/evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh:257 — The comment says "no pipeline.json, so no infrastructure_error row is possible". But a launcher that runs the arm without the context gets exit 2 with nothing written, and run-ablation.sh (lines 167-168, 1227) turns a missing pipeline.json into a synthesized `interrupted` row. The refusal then shows up as an unexplained interrupted trial with no evidence in the run directory. Either document that it becomes a row, or write a minimal refused record the runner can recognise.
head/evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh:341 — The dry-run `config_edits` line re-implements apply_arm_toggles' config mapping by hand in jq, and it reads the suite toggles (SUITE_TOGGLES) rather than the toggles resolve_arm_toggles returns, which are what the real run uses (TOGGLES, line 368). The plan the operator dry-runs can drift from what the sandbox actually gets, and no test cross-checks the two. Derive it from the library, or add a test that compares the dry-run edits with the snapshot config of a real run per arm.
head/evals/harness/validate-suite.sh:87 — The rule-id extraction only matches the exact form `rule_<id>() {` at column 0. A rule written as `rule_x () {`, `function rule_x`, or with the brace on the next line is silently missed, and the committed suite then fails with a misleading "unknown rule id". Use a looser pattern, or ask took-effect.sh for its rule list.
head/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml:41 — The PR title and description promise "the cycle-131 suite root (bounds 50/40) with its image self-check", but the diff contains no new suite root, no 50/40 bounds and no image self-check. Either the change is incomplete or the description is wrong. Reconcile the scope before merge.

head/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml:117 — The pre-registered rules block still says "expected false positives at 0.90 over 6 components printed", but the report now prints 9 components. The report quotes this block verbatim in its Method section, so it now contradicts the EFP sentence it prints.
head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:1930 — The EFP precision change from .1f to .2f silently rewrites the printed pre-registered sentence for every existing report (0.3 → 0.30, 0.6 → 0.60). Anything that quotes the old sentence (NOTES, earlier reports) no longer matches. This needs to be a deliberate, documented change, not a side effect.
head/evals/tests/run-ablation.bats:1174 — RAB-c131-4 still appends its own a0_bare_fable arm to a copy of the committed suite, which now declares a0_bare_fable too. That gives a duplicate arm id. run-ablation.sh:576 and pipeline-run.sh resolve arms by first match, so the committed definition (different took_effect list) wins. The test no longer exercises the arm it builds and passes or fails for reasons unrelated to its setup. Drop the append, as the PR did for c131_arms in pipeline-run.bats.
head/evals/harness/validate-suite.sh:157 — The new arm schema check (check 8) does not reject duplicate arm ids, although every consumer resolves an arm by first match (exactly the RAB-c131-4 case above). Add a duplicate-id violation alongside the toggle/took_effect/eval_only checks.
head/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml:100 — a1_review_only and a1_no_dissent (line 102) name the took-effect rules `review_only_phases` and `no_review_dissent_envelope`. took-effect.sh is not part of this change, and nothing else in the PR implements or exercises these rules (only the suite and the VS-14 name loop mention them). If they are not already defined, every trial of these two arms becomes infrastructure_error and pauses the arm, and validate-suite now fails the committed suite (VS-1/VS-14). Include or reference the rule implementations and a took-effect test for them.
head/evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh:257 — The comment says "no pipeline.json, so no infrastructure_error row is possible". But a launcher that runs the arm without the context gets exit 2 with nothing written, and run-ablation.sh (lines 167-168, 1227) turns a missing pipeline.json into a synthesized `interrupted` row. The refusal then shows up as an unexplained interrupted trial with no evidence in the run directory. Either document that it becomes a row, or write a minimal refused record the runner can recognise.
head/evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh:341 — The dry-run `config_edits` line re-implements apply_arm_toggles' config mapping by hand in jq, and it reads the suite toggles (SUITE_TOGGLES) rather than the toggles resolve_arm_toggles returns, which are what the real run uses (TOGGLES, line 368). The plan the operator dry-runs can drift from what the sandbox actually gets, and no test cross-checks the two. Derive it from the library, or add a test that compares the dry-run edits with the snapshot config of a real run per arm.
head/evals/harness/validate-suite.sh:87 — The rule-id extraction only matches the exact form `rule_<id>() {` at column 0. A rule written as `rule_x () {`, `function rule_x`, or with the brace on the next line is silently missed, and the committed suite then fails with a misleading "unknown rule id". Use a looser pattern, or ask took-effect.sh for its rule list.
head/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml:41 — The PR title and description promise "the cycle-131 suite root (bounds 50/40) with its image self-check", but the diff contains no new suite root, no 50/40 bounds and no image self-check. Either the change is incomplete or the description is wrong. Reconcile the scope before merge.
Verdict: CHANGES_REQUIRED

I've written the review to `/workspace/review.md`: 11 findings and **Verdict: CHANGES_REQUIRED**. This was a read-through only; I didn't run the bats tests or the scripts.

**Blocking issues:**
- **The open-mount arm vanishes from the report** (`ablation-report.py:1913`). Leaving the eval_only arm `a1_full_openmount` out of the list of decision arms also leaves it out of everything the report prints: per-arm detail, decisions and all the sensitivity tables. The open-mount vs closed-mount comparison it exists to produce never appears.
- **Three control arms become decision arms.** `a0_bare_fable`, `a1_review_only` and `a1_no_dissent` now get keep/remove verdicts against `a1_full`, which makes no sense for a baseline variant. This also raises the count from 6 to 9, so the expected-false-positive figure changes after the analysis was pre-registered. The suite's pre-registered rules (`ablation-2.0.yaml:117`) still say "over 6 components".
- **A stale test** (`run-ablation.bats:1174`, RAB-c131-4). It still adds its own `a0_bare_fable` to a copy of the committed suite, which now declares that arm too. Arms are looked up by first match, so the test runs the committed definition, not the one it builds.
- **The PR is missing promised work.** The description promises "the cycle-131 suite root (bounds 50/40) with its image self-check", but nothing in the diff implements it.

**Smaller issues:**
- **Possibly missing check rules.** `review_only_phases` and `no_review_dissent_envelope` are used by two of the new arms, but `took-effect.sh` isn't in this PR, so I couldn't confirm they exist. If they don't, every trial of those arms fails and `validate-suite` rejects the committed suite.
- **Fragile rule-name parsing.** `validate-suite.sh` reads the rule names from `took-effect.sh` with a pattern that only matches the exact form `rule_<id>() {`. Any other way of writing a function is missed and reported as an unknown rule.
- **No duplicate-arm-id check.** The new arm checks in `validate-suite.sh` don't catch two arms with the same id.
- **Misleading refusal comment.** In `pipeline-run.sh` the comment says a refused eval_only run can't produce an error row. In fact `run-ablation.sh` would record the missing result as an `interrupted` row.
- **Dry-run can drift from real runs.** The dry-run's list of config edits is a hand-written copy of the mount library's logic, and it reads different toggles from the ones a real run uses.
- **Changed number format.** The expected-false-positive sentence now prints two decimals, which silently changes it in every existing report (0.3 → 0.30).
